summary: Bundled Clash MCP tools for Assets, Canvas, plugin lifecycle, and native Blender/Maya control.
architecture_notes: ClashMcpServer owns the fixed progressive-disclosure dispatchers. Native DCC operations are clash_plugin_dcc_* leaves under the existing clash_plugin dispatcher, never a separate user-configured MCP service.

dcc.ts discovers the native addon for the requested real working folder through machine-private ~/.clash/dcc-connections records. It only connects to loopback, binds app/workspace/session identity, and never returns session credentials to the agent.
Native Python execution is full local application access, not a sandbox. Unknown mutation outcomes are never retried automatically.
The native adapters in integrations/dcc-assets run all application API operations on their UI thread and publish media through the existing Clash Asset CLI authority.

The fullscreen Project App embeds the shared shipped web renderer served by local-api. Native host context replaces agent GUI; project-app-native only relays context and display mode, never ACP sessions.
Source quality checks use tsconfig.dev.json with the common workspace source map; root make lint runs this typecheck through dependency-aware Turbo without requiring packaged dist.

key_files.src/server.ts: Composes the bundled tools, including native DCC operations.
key_files.src/dcc.ts: MCP native-control contracts, loopback transport, and screenshot image results.
key_files.dcc_maya_tools / dcc_maya_call: Progressive discovery and validated execution of the native Maya addon bundled MayaMCP operations under clash_plugin.
key_files.src/dcc-transport.test.ts: Real Node-to-Python plugin transport, workspace discovery and ambiguous-outcome tests.
key_files.src/dcc.test.ts: Exercises native operations through the actual MCP client and existing plugin dispatcher.
key_files.src/project-app.ts: Registers clash_project_open and the UI resource using the discovered daemon origin.
key_files.src/project-app-client.ts: MCP App SDK lifecycle and validated iframe context bridge.
